title: service.permissions.declared payload
description:
Payload for `service.permissions.declared`, published by every service through the SDK's `PermissionsDeclarator` to announce the permissions it defines. This is the data source ADR-0024 §2 builds the permission catalogue on — the catalogue is what makes a role meaning "everything" expressible without a wildcard on the wire.

Note the routing key: the literal `service` is the first segment, not the publishing service's name. It is a platform-level declaration rather than one service's domain event, and the publisher is carried in the envelope's `source`.

The file name is the routing key — that is how `SchemaDiscovery` keys the catalog.

service.description: Name of the declaring service, matching the first segment of every permission below and the `service_name` in its service token (ADR-0005).

permissions.description: Every permission this service defines, each fully literal. Wildcards are refused on the wire (ADR-0024), so a declaration cannot say `crm.*` — the catalogue exists precisely so that nothing has to.
